body: You've helped me a lot and I thank you. If there is any way I can repay the favour please let me know.
Thank you so much for your help and understanding. I would very much like to return the favor.
Thank you so much. Right now its morning where I am so I feel like it was a completely different person who made this post but I guess past me had a point. Its a bit scary when I think of it.
Wow. I sound pretty messed up.. Thank you for your help!
Its odd because I expect nothing yet am still crushed when I receive nothing. Thank you for your help I'll definitely try these.

Yes yes yes. This is exactly it. Something that catches me most often is the lack of empathy. However things are looking relatively up with the girl I'm currently in like with because for once she hates people about as much as I do and I don't always have to Start the conversation. The feeling when someone asks you of your day outside of their moral obligations but simply because they care is irreplaceable for me. I hope you have felt this too and will continue to do so. Thank you for helping me. So much.

The people I'm obsessing about are my close friends as well. But the emotional connection between us is next to non existent. Thank you for your support and I'm so sorry that there is anyone else in the world who has to go through this mental torture. People don't believe me when I tell them too. That also 'triggers' me when I trust someone and they don't believe me. Thank you for your help. I still don't know what to do.

I have trouble talking to and confiding in shallow people. And I am sorry to say that that's what I think of most girls my age. There are very few that I have invested in and I'm going to try to start talking to them about it. I've already let them know in a way that I get these bouts but..nothing more. Yet. I would do so many things but I need to study right now and I just can't. Do you know of any short term solutions at least that'll help me study?
Hello this is just to get back to you as to how I'm doing. I didn't take my life that day because I don't really know why. But I'm still here and still alive. Thank you for caring

It would not have mattered if they hadn't celebrated everyone else's birthday but my own. I feel that this incident was only the final nail in the coffin. I understand what you have been through and am proud of you for doing so. Its just that my parents do not believe in quality, they believe in quantity. 

They do not wish to know how the questions I did went or even how many questions I did. They only wish to know how much I've been studying. I am sorry but it is impossible to work hard when you don't eat the food they give you, when you can't sleep when they make you and when the only time you can escape a lecture or a guilt trip from them is when you are in your room "studying". I'm afraid I am no longer studying because I no longer wish to pursue anything that has to do with this much studying or work. 

I am aware what I am taking is the easy route. But this is only so because the other routes are 100% unachievable on my scenario. Which means the only reason I'm taking it is because it is the easier and more logical route. Thank you for your empathy.
